description:
The hunt for Illuminor Szeras has led the Dark Angels to the surface of a forgotten world.

Tracking the elusive Necron scientist to one of his hidden complexes, the sons of the Lion have arrived at the very gates of his subterranean domain. However Szeras has no intention of allowing the intruders to proceed.

James and Luka present this 2,000 point Matched Play Battle Report between the Dark Angels and Necrons.
